infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) needs access to your microphone so you can talk during audio and video calls.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) needs access to your camera so you can be seen during video calls.

plugins.photosPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) needs access to your photos so you can attach images to chat messages.
plugins.cameraPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) needs access to your camera so you can take photos and send them in chat.

plugins.photosPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) needs access to your photos so you can attach them to chat messages.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) needs access to your photos so you can save media you receive in chat.
